title.value: Determinants of technology adoption and continued use among cognitively impaired older adults: a qualitative study
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the primary focus of the research paper, which is on the determinants affecting technology adoption and continued use by cognitively impaired older adults.
title.quote: Determinants of technology adoption and continued use among cognitively impaired older adults: a qualitative study

extractions.description: This qualitative study examines the factors influencing technology adoption and continued usage among community-dwelling older adults with mild cognitive impairments. It explores the role of individual, technological, and contextual factors in enhancing or hindering technology use. By drawing insights from interviews and focus groups, the research identifies key facilitators and barriers affecting the adoption and sustained use of technology among this population.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper does not directly address Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development as its central theme. Instead, it focuses on technology adoption among cognitively impaired older adults, with an emphasis on their independence and social connectivity rather than environmental sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This study aimed to bridge this gap in research by examining the factors underlying technology use in community-dwelling older adults with mild cognitive impairments.

primary_category.justification: The main focus of this paper is on social and technological factors affecting the elderly with cognitive impairments, without a direct connection to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_category.quote: Successful technology adoption in cognitively impaired older adults is need-driven and subject to individual, technological and contextual characteristics.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address other Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories related to its discussion on technology adoption among older adults with cognitive impairments.
secondary_categories.quote: Although social support can be a valuable alternative to technology, it is an important facilitator of continued technology use in these older adults.

primary_sub_category.justification: The study does not align with any of the specific Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development sub-categories, instead focusing on aspects of gerontechnology and healthcare for older adults.
primary_sub_category.quote: We identified two themes: introduction of technology and determinants of technology adoption and continued use.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no other sub-categories from the list that this paper addresses, as its primary focus is on factors influencing technology use in a specific population, without ecological or climate connection.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Specific for older adults with cognitive impairments are the importance of disease awareness and cognitive ability for adoption and continued use, respectively.

applications.value: Enhancing technology use among cognitively impaired older adults
applications.justification: The paper identifies enhancing technology use in older adults with cognitive impairments to support independence and social connection as the central application, though this is not directly related to environmental sustainability.
applications.quote: Technology offers opportunities to support older adults with mild cognitive impairments to remain independent and socially connected, but is often not used.

new_primary_category.justification: The study does not introduce a new category related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development since it primarily deals with gerontechnology and healthcare.
new_primary_category.quote: Moreover, identification of crucial determinants as well as strategies to remove use barriers are also important future research tasks.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no new sub-category related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development introduced by the paper, as the focus is on gerontechnological aspects.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Successful technology adoption in cognitively impaired older adults is need-driven and subject to individual, technological and contextual characteristics.
